title: Pineapple: The Fruit That Digests You
hook: Eating fresh pineapple means it’s digesting you back?
script: Eating fresh pineapple means it’s digesting you back? It contains bromelain, an enzyme that breaks down protein. Bromelain targets the proteins in your saliva, dissolving cells. Your mouth regenerates quickly, replacing cells every 3 to 7 days. Interestingly, canned pineapple doesn't have this effect. This is because heat destroys the enzyme bromelain. Only raw pineapple bites back, making it unique. So, would you eat raw pineapple again knowing this?
